explanation: Keep the best run length and examine candidate windows of that length backward. A nonincreasing adjacent pair rules out starts up through that pair; otherwise extend the candidate forward until its increasing run ends and update the answer.
timeComplexity: O(n^2) safe worst-case upper bound for the backward-window/forward-extension scan.
